compound.name: (-)-α-bisabolol (levomenol)
compound.one_liner: Chamomile oil's anti-inflammatory alcohol (up to 50 % of oil in the bisabolol chemotype).

identity.note: Chamomile form is (-)-α-bisabolol = levomenol. Note: PubChem CID 1549992 titled 'Bisabolol' (CAS 515-69-5) is the (2R,1R) enantiomer - do not use it for chamomile. ChEBI ID 'CHEBI:125' as returned by the summariser; unusually low, so re-check it.

occurrences.source_citation: EMA/HMPC. Assessment report on Matricaria recutita L., flos and Matricaria recutita L., aetheroleum. EMA/HMPC/55837/2011 (7 Jul 2015). https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/herbal-report/final-assessment-report-matricaria-recutita-l-flos-and-matricaria-recutita-l-aetheroleum-first-version_en.pdf-0
occurrences.database: Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases
occurrences.note: EMA: (-)-alpha-bisabolol up to 50 %; oil 0.3-1.9 % of flower. Duke: ALPHA-BISABOLOL Flower 725-10000 ppm. | Basis as recorded: % of essential oil

pharmacology.mechanism: In rats it decreased leukocyte migration, protein extravasation and TNF-α in paw oedema and inhibited experimental gastric ulcers; on guinea-pig ileum it was 91 % as effective as papaverine against barium chloride spasms [10].

compound.absorption_bioavailability: No human absorption data found in the EMA report [10].

evidence.claim: α-Bisabolol is anti-inflammatory and anti-ulcer in rats.
evidence.test_article_detail: α-bisabolol, rat paw oedema and ulcer models (EMA summary)
evidence.outcome_summary: Reduced leukocyte migration, TNF-α and ulcers.

evidence.claim: α-Bisabolol is spasmolytic on isolated ileum.

processing_stability.volatility: steam-volatile: recovered in hydro/steam-distilled essential oil (see occurrence sources)
processing_stability.note: Solubility and heat-stability values not sourced in this pass.

compound.teaching_note: Identity trap: PubChem 'Bisabolol' (CID 1549992) is the wrong enantiomer; chamomile's compound is levomenol (CID 442343).
gaps: ChEBI id: verification returned CHEBI:125, judged wrong; left null pending re-check.
